name: SurveySensum
description_en:
SurveySensum combines customer surveys, text analysis, dashboards and follow-up workflows, with options for a team to operate the programme itself or receive managed CX assistance. Its website-feedback offer is one channel within a broader platform that also names market research, employee experience and conversation analytics.

Selection depends on the annual response allowance and the amount of implementation or consulting support required. Several statements in the retrieved pages conflict about free use, onboarding and compliance scope. This profile preserves those conflicts instead of treating promotional headlines as confirmed contractual entitlement.
description_zh:
SurveySensum 结合客户问卷、文字分析、仪表盘和跟进流程，可以由团队自行运营，也可采购托管 CX 支持。网站反馈只是渠道之一，平台另列市场研究、员工体验及对话分析。

选型取决于年度回答量和所需实施或咨询支持。本次页面对免费使用、上线支持及合规范围有多处冲突，本文保留差异，不把宣传标题当成已确认合同权益。

core_features.explanation_en: CX tiers describe email, WhatsApp, in-app, SMS and CRM distribution.
core_features.explanation_zh: CX 套餐介绍邮件、WhatsApp、应用内、短信及 CRM 分发。

core_features.explanation_en: Analyze sentiment and themes, then route findings through configured dashboards and workflows.
core_features.explanation_zh: 分析情绪与主题，再通过已配置仪表盘和流程分发处理。

en: Collect website feedback and assign low-score follow-up to a responsible team.
zh: 收集网站反馈，并由明确团队跟进低评分。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Define the touchpoint, response budget, implementation owner and required suite before requesting a scoped demo and quote.
steps.zh: 申请演示和报价前，定义触点、回答预算、实施负责人及所需套件。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Custom annual CX package by response allowance and managed services; channel and optional service costs require confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: CX subscription amounts require a quote. Starter 6,000 responses/year; Self-Driven 12,000; Managed advertises unlimited responses. Optional implementation $50/hour and CX consultation $100/session are separate service prices. Annual plans have no refund; one-month/25-response trial and sustained-free conditions contain conflicting page language.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: CX 订阅金额需询价。Starter 每年 6,000 条、Self-Driven 12,000 条，Managed 宣传回答不限。可选实施每小时 $50、CX 咨询每场 $100 为单独服务价格。年度套餐不退款；一个月/25 条试用和持续免费条件存在页面冲突。

sources.title: SurveySensum | AI-Enabled Customer Feedback Platform
sources.research_notes_en: CX-oriented feedback collection and text analysis platform; separate research/EX/conversation analytics suites.

sources.title: Website Feedback Tool | SurveySensum
sources.research_notes_en: Website feedback, role dashboards and business integrations. Legacy free-forever claims conflict with current pricing trial description.

sources.title: SurveySensum Pricing - Affordable plans for actionable feedback
sources.research_notes_en: Quote-led CX tiers, annual response limits, optional expert services, annual cancellation and inconsistent implementation/compliance wording.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Define the touchpoint and its follow-up owner
sections.title_zh: 确定触点与跟进负责人
sections.en: A website-feedback programme can start from a template, customize questions and branding, collect answers and review CSAT or NPS alongside themes. Role-based dashboards let different teams view relevant results. For an illustrative low-score follow-up, preserve the customer context and define who should act; a score on a dashboard alone does not close a customer issue. Verify the real CRM connector and field mapping rather than inferring universal synchronization from its name.
sections.zh: 网站反馈可从模板开始，调整题目和品牌，收集后结合主题查看 CSAT 或 NPS。按角色的仪表盘让不同团队看相关结果。例如低分跟进，应保留客户上下文并指定负责人；仪表盘出现评分并不表示问题已经解决。应核对真实 CRM 连接与字段映射，不能由名称推断全量同步。

sections.title_zh: 区分自行运营与托管服务
sections.en: Starter CX lists 6,000 responses yearly, unlimited users and projects, distribution and selected integrations. Self-Driven CX lists 12,000 yearly responses plus closed-loop work and basic text analysis. Managed CX adds unlimited responses, broader AI use, dedicated consulting and custom dashboards. These labels define materially different operating responsibilities. No public subscription amount was resolved; the page asks buyers to discuss their use case.
sections.zh: Starter CX 列每年 6,000 条回答、不限用户与项目、分发及部分集成；Self-Driven CX 为每年 12,000 条，增加反馈闭环及基础文字分析；Managed CX 增加不限回答、更多 AI 用量、专属咨询及定制仪表盘。不同名称对应实质不同的运营责任。本次未确定公开订阅金额，页面要求结合使用场景洽谈。

sections.en: The pricing headline offers a one-month trial with 25 responses and all features, while its FAQ says key features and asks buyers to book a demo for full AI and implementation access. The website product page also advertises a free-forever version. Pricing sections variously include onboarding from Self-Driven and in every plan. Compliance language likewise differs between tier cards and the FAQ. Do not promise sustained free access, full AI or uniform onboarding without written confirmation.
sections.zh: 价格标题称一个月试用、25 条回答和全部功能，FAQ 却称关键功能，并要求通过演示取得完整 AI 与实施；网站产品页还宣传永久免费版本。不同定价段落分别称上线支持从 Self-Driven 起，或所有套餐包含。合规范围在卡片与 FAQ 中也有差异。未取得书面确认前，不应承诺持续免费、完整 AI 或统一上线支持。

sections.title_en: Budget annual access and post-launch assistance
sections.title_zh: 预算年度访问与上线后支持
sections.en: The FAQ describes annual billing and no refunds on annual plans; cancellation leaves access through the billing-period end. Optional post-launch implementation support is displayed at $50 per hour and CX consultation at $100 per session, not as the platform subscription price. Confirm currency, taxes, migration, channel-message costs and support scope in the quote. Unlimited responses in Managed CX do not establish unlimited third-party messaging spend.
sections.zh: FAQ 说明采用年付，年度套餐不退款，取消后可用至账期结束。可选上线后实施支持列为每小时 $50、CX 咨询每场 $100，它们不是平台订阅价。报价需确认币种、税费、迁移、渠道消息成本及支持范围。Managed CX 回答不限，不表示第三方消息支出也不限。

sections.title_en: Treat AI and hosting claims as configuration questions
sections.title_zh: 把 AI 与托管主张落实为配置问题
sections.en: SurveySensum merits investigation when feedback analysis and programme help matter alongside survey collection. Compare AI-derived themes with original comments and test a real follow-up path. Vendor conversion, savings and response-rate examples were not independently measured. Native-country hosting is advertised, but exact available regions and contractual safeguards were not established. No self-hosted package or open-source license was verified.
sections.zh: 在问卷之外还需要反馈分析与项目支持时，可以研究 SurveySensum。应把 AI 主题与原始评论对照，并测试真实跟进路径。本文未独立测量转化、节省或回答率案例。官网宣传本国托管，但准确可选地区与合同保障未确认，也未核实自托管服务包或开源许可。

research_gaps: No account, website installation, channel delivery, AI analysis, CRM workflow or migration was tested.
Official pages conflict on sustained free use, trial feature scope, onboarding and compliance eligibility; written clarification required.
Subscription amounts, currency, message charges, contractual storage region/retention, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
